proposal.reason: Primary change is a full CI pipeline redesign: replacing pr-test-ppu with source-sanity, adding CSV-driven case execution/reconciliation tooling, artifact-backed build/cache staging, and new CI validation tests/contracts for job orchestration and result gating. Add workflow because the PR also substantively changes contribution/review policy wiring (secret-scan/commit checks, AI+human approval gates, and explicit fork/unsupported-event handling) beyond mechanical CI execution edits.
